R = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'

with zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx') as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("Zip entries:", names)

    sst = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall(f'{{{M}}}si'):
            sst.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(f'{{{M}}}t')))
    print("sharedStrings count:", len(sst))

    wbroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheet_els = wbroot.find(f'{{{M}}}sheets')
    print("sheets:")
    for s in sheet_els:
        print("  ", s.attrib)

    relroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    relmap = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in relroot}
    print("workbook rels:", relmap)

    for s in sheet_els:
        rid = s.get(f'{{{R}}}id')
        target = relmap.get(rid)
        if target and not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target
        print(f"\n=== Sheet {s.get('name')} -> {target} ===")
        sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        sdata = sroot.find(f'{{{M}}}sheetData')
        rows = sdata.findall(f'{{{M}}}row')
        print("rows:", len(rows))
        for row in rows[:8]:
            vals = []
            for c in row.findall(f'{{{M}}}c'):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find(f'{{{M}}}v')

                if t == 's' and v is not None:
                    val = sst[int(v.text)]
                elif t == 'inlineStr' and isel is not None:
                    val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in isel.iter(f'{{{M}}}t'))
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                else:

                vals.append(f"{ref}={val!r}(t={t})")
            print(" | ".join(vals))

    for s in sheet_els:
        rid = s.get(f'{{{R}}}id')

            target = target.lstrip('/')

            target = 'xl/' + target
        print(f"\n=== Sheet {s.get('name')} -> {target} ===")

                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find(f'{{{M}}}v')
                isel = c.find(f'{{{M}}}is')
                if t == 's' and v is not None:
                    val = sst[int(v.text)]
                elif t == 'inlineStr' and isel is not None:
                    val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in isel.iter(f'{{{M}}}t'))
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                else:
                    val = ''
                vals.append(f"{ref}={val!r}(t={t})")
            print(" | ".join(vals))

        # styles: number formats
        stroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/styles.xml'))
        numfmts = stroot.find(f'{{{M}}}numFmts')

        if numfmts is not None:

                print("   ", nf.attrib)
        cellxfs = stroot.find(f'{{{M}}}cellXfs')
        if cellxfs is not None:
            print("cellXfs count:", len(cellxfs))
            for i, xf in enumerate(cellxfs[:15]):
                print("   xf", i, xf.attrib)

import os, re, zipfile

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    entries = {i.filename: zin.read(i.filename) for i in zin.infolist()}

styles = entries['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# capture first <xf ...> element as template for the new percentage style
m0 = re.search(r'<xf\b.*?(?:/>|</xf>)', styles, re.S)
assert m0, "no xf found in styles.xml"
tmpl = m0.group(0)

# find current cellXfs count
mc = re.search(r'<cellXfs count="(\d+)"', styles)
assert mc, "no cellXfs count"
cur_count = int(mc.group(1))
new_idx = cur_count  # new style will be appended at this 0-based index

# build new xf: same as default xf but with built-in percentage format 0.00% (numFmtId=10)
newxf = re.sub(r'numFmtId="\d+"', 'numFmtId="10"', tmpl)
if re.search(r'applyNumberFormat="\d"', newxf):
    newxf = re.sub(r'applyNumberFormat="\d"', 'applyNumberFormat="1"', newxf)
else:
    newxf = newxf.replace('<xf ', '<xf applyNumberFormat="1" ', 1)

styles = styles.replace('</cellXfs>', newxf + '</cellXfs>', 1)
styles = re.sub(r'(<cellXfs count=")\d+(")', lambda m: m.group(1) + str(cur_count + 1) + m.group(2), styles, count=1)
entries['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

sheet = entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# extend dimension
sheet = sheet.replace('ref="A1:G10"', 'ref="A1:H10"', 1)

# add width for column H
sheet = sheet.replace('</cols>', '<col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>', 1)

# header cell H1
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '</row><row r="2">',
    '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row><row r="2">',
    1)

# data rows 2..9: profit margin = Profit / Revenue, guarded against div-by-zero
for r in range(2, 10):
    cell = f'<c r="H{r}" s="{new_idx}"><f>IFERROR(G{r}/E{r},"")</f><v></v></c>'
    sheet = re.sub(r'(<row r="%d">.*?)</row>' % r,
                   lambda m, c=cell: m.group(1) + c + '</row>',
                   sheet, count=1)

# TOTAL row margin
cell10 = f'<c r="H10" s="2"><f>IFERROR(G10/E10,"")</f><v></v></c>'
sheet = re.sub(r'(<row r="10">.*?)</row>',
               lambda m: m.group(1) + cell10 + '</row>',
               sheet, count=1)
entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)

os.replace(TMP, SRC)

# in-place verification

    st = z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')
print("dimension ok:", 'ref="A1:H10"' in s)
print("H1 ok:", '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c>' in s)
print("H2 ok:", '<c r="H2" s="%d"><f>IFERROR(G2/E2,"")</f>' % new_idx in s)
print("H9 ok:", '<c r="H9" s="%d"><f>IFERROR(G9/E9,"")</f>' % new_idx in s)
print("H10 ok:", '<c r="H10" s="2"><f>IFERROR(G10/E10,"")</f>' in s)
print("col H ok:", '<col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>' in s)

import os, re, zipfile

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    entries = {i.filename: zin.read(i.filename) for i in zin.infolist()}

sheet = entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')

def num(ref):
    m = re.search(r'<c r="%s"[^>]*>(?:<f>.*?</f>)?<v>(.*?)</v></c>' % ref, sheet)
    assert m, "missing cell " + ref
    return float(m.group(1))

vals = {}
for r in range(2, 10):
    c, d, f = num(f'C{r}'), num(f'D{r}'), num(f'F{r}')
    e = c * d
    g = e - c * f
    vals[f'E{r}'] = e
    vals[f'G{r}'] = g
    vals[f'H{r}'] = g / e

vals['C10'] = sum(vals[f'C{r}'] for r in range(2, 10) if False)  # placeholder, replaced below
vals['C10'] = sum(num(f'C{r}') for r in range(2, 10))
vals['E10'] = sum(vals[f'E{r}'] for r in range(2, 10))
vals['G10'] = sum(vals[f'G{r}'] for r in range(2, 10))
vals['H10'] = vals['G10'] / vals['E10']

def fmt(x):
    return str(int(x)) if float(x).is_integer() else repr(x)

formulas = {f'E{r}': f'C{r}*D{r}' for r in range(2, 10)}
formulas.update({f'G{r}': f'E{r}-C{r}*F{r}' for r in range(2, 10)})
formulas.update({f'H{r}': f'IFERROR(G{r}/E{r},"")' for r in range(2, 10)})
formulas.update({'C10': 'SUM(C2:C9)', 'E10': 'SUM(E2:E9)', 'G10': 'SUM(G2:G9)',
                 'H10': 'IFERROR(G10/E10,"")'})

for ref, ftext in formulas.items():
    pat = re.compile(r'(<c r="%s"><f>%s</f>)<v></v>(</c>)' % (ref, re.escape(ftext)))
    sheet, n = pat.subn(lambda m: m.group(1) + f'<v>{fmt(vals[ref])}</v>' + m.group(2), sheet)
    assert n == 1, f"cell {ref} not updated (n={n})"

entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)

os.replace(TMP, SRC)

print(f"{'TOTAL':<5}{vals['E10']:>10.2f}{'':>10}{vals['G10']:>10.2f}{vals['H10']*100:>9.2f}%")

errors = [e for e in ('#REF!', '#DIV/0!', '#VALUE!', '#N/A', '#NAME?', '#NUM!', '#NULL!') if e in s]
print("formula errors found:", errors if errors else "none")

import os, re, zipfile

styles = entries['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# capture first <xf ...> element as template for the new percentage style
m0 = re.search(r'<xf\b.*?(?:/>|</xf>)', styles, re.S)
assert m0, "no xf found in styles.xml"
tmpl = m0.group(0)

# find current cellXfs count
mc = re.search(r'<cellXfs count="(\d+)"', styles)
assert mc, "no cellXfs count"
cur_count = int(mc.group(1))
new_idx = cur_count  # new style will be appended at this 0-based index

# build new xf: same as default xf but with built-in percentage format 0.00% (numFmtId=10)
newxf = re.sub(r'numFmtId="\d+"', 'numFmtId="10"', tmpl)
if re.search(r'applyNumberFormat="\d"', newxf):
    newxf = re.sub(r'applyNumberFormat="\d"', 'applyNumberFormat="1"', newxf)
else:
    newxf = newxf.replace('<xf ', '<xf applyNumberFormat="1" ', 1)

styles = styles.replace('</cellXfs>', newxf + '</cellXfs>', 1)
styles = re.sub(r'(<cellXfs count=")\d+(")', lambda m: m.group(1) + str(cur_count + 1) + m.group(2), styles, count=1)
entries['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

sheet = entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# extend dimension
sheet = sheet.replace('ref="A1:G10"', 'ref="A1:H10"', 1)

# add width for column H
sheet = sheet.replace('</cols>', '<col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>', 1)

# header cell H1
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '</row><row r="2">',
    '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row><row r="2">',
    1)

# data rows 2..9: profit margin = Profit / Revenue, guarded against div-by-zero
for r in range(2, 10):
    cell = f'<c r="H{r}" s="{new_idx}"><f>IFERROR(G{r}/E{r},"")</f><v></v></c>'
    sheet = re.sub(r'(<row r="%d">.*?)</row>' % r,
                   lambda m, c=cell: m.group(1) + c + '</row>',
                   sheet, count=1)

# TOTAL row margin
cell10 = f'<c r="H10" s="2"><f>IFERROR(G10/E10,"")</f><v></v></c>'
sheet = re.sub(r'(<row r="10">.*?)</row>',
               lambda m: m.group(1) + cell10 + '</row>',
               sheet, count=1)
entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
